content: लग्न {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Adhered or clung to, stuck, held fast; लताविटपे एकावली लग्ना <ls>V. 1</ls>. .²2 Touching, coming in contact with. .²3 Attached to, connected with. .²4 Clinging or sticking to, remaining on; उवाच रामं संप्रेक्ष्य पङ्कलग्न इव द्विपः <ls>Rām. 4. 18. 49</ls>. .²5 Cutting, meeting (as lines) .²6 Following closely, impending. .²7 Busy with, closely occupied about; परे ब्रह्मणि कोऽपि न लग्नः <ls>Skanda P.</ls> .²8 Fastened on, directed towards. .²9 Ashamed. .²10 -Consumed, spent; <ls>Ms. 7. 127</ls> (<ab>com.</ab>) .²11 Auspicious; (see लग्). .{@-ग्नः@} .²1 A bard, minstrel. .²2 An elephant in rut. .{@-ग्नम्@} .²1 The point of contact or intersection, the point where the horizon and the ecliptic or the path of planets meet. .²2 The point of the ecliptic which at any given time is at the horizon or on the meridian. .²3 The rising of the sun or of the planets. .²4 The moment of the sunʼs entrance into a zodiacal sign. .²5 A figure of the twelve zodiacal signs. .²6 An auspicious or lucky moment. .²7 (Hence) A decisive moment, time for action.
